svg.title: How the libraries fit
svg.desc: prisma-map is the base: json-rules and permissions read its map. permissions is built on json-rules. transitions is built on json-rules and permissions. rules-builder is built on json-rules. Developer experience: atlas (uses json-rules), gloss, config (the toolchain under every package), and the worktrees, init and CI rules that come with template. template uses prisma-map, json-rules, permissions, rules-builder, atlas and config, and moves onto transitions and gloss next.

path.title: json-rules reads the field map prisma-map produces
permissions walks your data through the map prisma-map produces
a transition is checked by permissions
atlas checks its annotations with json-rules

a.aria-label: prisma-map: Your Prisma schema, readable at runtime. Built on config. Used by json-rules, permissions, template.
a.text: The schema the stack is written against

a.aria-label: json-rules: One rule that runs in memory, in Prisma and in SQL. Built on prisma-map, config. Used by permissions, transitions, rules-builder, atlas, template.
a.text: Rule logic, lenses and sources; check, or compile to Prisma and SQL

a.aria-label: permissions: RBAC, ABAC and ReBAC on your own records. Built on prisma-map, json-rules, config. Used by transitions, template.
a.text: Who can do what, decided with json-rules

a.aria-label: transitions: Declarative lifecycles. Built on json-rules, permissions, config. Used by template.
rules-builder: A headless rule builder. Built on json-rules, config. Used by template.
atlas: A map of your code. Built on json-rules, config. Used by template.
gloss: Explanations kept out of the source. Built on config. Used by template.
a.text: Explanations kept out of the source

a.aria-label: worktrees: A worktree per task, with its own database and ports. Used by template.
init: Sets up hosting, database and secrets for a new project. Used by template.
CI rules: Checks that hold the codebase to its own conventions. Used by template.
config: The shared toolchain and theme. Used by template, prisma-map, json-rules, permissions, transitions, rules-builder, atlas, gloss.
template: The whole SaaS app, built from the libraries. Under construction. Built on prisma-map, json-rules, permissions, rules-builder, atlas, config, worktrees, init, CI rules, transitions, gloss.
